title: Flat brand mascot
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Refine this exact geometric design into an exceptionally cute, ownable premium AI BOT mascot for 'mory', a personal memory system. Mory's selected 09A identity is a mathematically regular, bilaterally symmetric rounded square: main body front silhouette 160 units wide by 160 units high, corner radius 48 units. Centered horizontal warm-ivory pill face window 98.9 units wide by 61.1 units high (width is body width divided by phi), radius 30.55 units. Inside the window two dark-green vertical capsule eyes, each 12 by 24 units, centered horizontally at x=107 and x=149 relative to a 256-unit canvas with body x=48..208; same exact eye sizes. Main body deep evergreen #123F34, face warm ivory #FAF9F5, optional tiny butter-yellow #F5D873 accent. Top contour is one uninterrupted rounded-square contour: absolutely no M notch, paired humps, ears, horns, antenna, head/body split or organic bean silhouette. Add only two tiny rounded capsule arms integrated at lower sides and two very short symmetrical rounded feet beneath, all substantially smaller than body. Bot is head-and-body unified in one squircle. Endearing but restrained: large empty face window, attentive capsule eyes, slight forward lean, short limbs, confident symmetry. Character must feel like a small friend that remembers you, not a generic robot stock asset. No mouth, nose, blush, eyebrows, fingers, buttons, tech panels, cables, logos from existing brands, hats or clothing. No buttocks-like contours. Preserve clean geometry even when cute. Square presentation board with generous warm off-white whitespace: one large full-body neutral front view occupying central upper 65%, understated lowercase 'mory' beneath; a coherent bottom strip of three smaller character states CURIOUS / HAPPY / SLEEPING. Same anatomy and proportions for every state; emotions primarily through eye shape, slight tilt and arms. Small app-icon preview in top right, faithful to the main square body without limbs for small-size readability. Minimal exact text only: 'mory', '09A', and the three state labels. No geometry diagrams, no decorative sparkles, no crowded callouts. Rendering style: meticulously clean flat vector-like solid color illustration, no gradients, no textures, no 3D or shadows. Express cuteness through proportions and warm gestures, not extra details. The neutral main character has both tiny arms angled slightly outward as if greeting, feet planted, aligned equal-size pill eyes. Happy state eyes become two upside-down U arcs. Sleeping state eyes become two soft closed arcs. Make this a polished brand mascot artboard with clear readable logo quality.
